tools.name: get_api_credit_balance
tools.description: API credit balance: prepaid credits left for SEO data calls, amount spent, whether spending is suspended, and the per-call pricing rule. Free; no supplier call.

tools.name: check_google_rankings
tools.description: Check Google rankings: the live Google position and ranking URL of a domain for up to 10 keywords in one country, with the top competing domains. Costs API credits per keyword.

tools.name: get_ranked_keywords
tools.description: Ranked keywords: every Google keyword a domain or URL ranks for in one country, with position, ranking URL, search volume, difficulty and estimated traffic, highest traffic first. Costs API credits per call.

tools.name: find_competitor_keywords
tools.description: Competitor keywords: keywords a competitor domain ranks for in Google that your domain does not, with search volume, difficulty and the competitor's position. Costs API credits per call.

tools.name: find_competitor_domains
tools.description: Competitor domains: the domains competing with a domain in Google organic search, with shared keywords, average position and estimated traffic. Costs API credits per call.
